In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 15.0 to 15.8 s medium framing on the car in brown water. The far-bank trees slide left between samples while the car holds near frame center. The tilt is modest; the car does not visibly rotate sideways. Cabin windows show seat shapes with no person.
